title: Deterministic verification adapters
canonical_definition: For workloads whose result can be independently recomputed.

roadmap_order.note: CMP-1.4.4 remains open. CMP-1.4.7 provides deterministic recomputation evidence only and does not claim canonical signed-verdict completion.

milestone_relationship.rationale: CMP-1.4.7 introduces deterministic-only semantics without changing shared job/verdict/settlement authority. Broader integration is most meaningful once scientific/probabilistic verification exists alongside deterministic adapters.

implementation.route_rule: Governance publishes exact workload/profile -> adapter routes with immutable code hash and versioned activation.
implementation.binding_rule: Job owner freezes the exact current adapter revision/code hash/schema while the job is ACCEPTED and before execution.
implementation.evaluation_rule: After RESULT_COMMITTED, router reproduces canonical input/output commitments, proves the output preimage matches the worker's committed outputHash, invokes the exact frozen adapter, and stores deterministic evidence.
implementation.authority_rule: Router produces positive/negative deterministic evidence only; it does not submit a signed verdict or mutate job/settlement state.

authority_boundaries: Adapter registration grants no verifier identity/class/capability, appointment, verdict, settlement, custody, stake/slash, worker, governance, validator, bridge or wallet authority.
The router cannot reinterpret an accepted job using a later adapter revision because each job freezes exact adapter revision/address/code hash before execution.
Adapter code hash drift fails closed.
Deterministic evaluation must bind canonical committed input and the worker's actual committed output hash.
Positive/negative evaluation evidence is not itself PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE and does not transition ComputeJobRegistry420.
The reference integer adapter proves only one bounded deterministic arithmetic workload and is not generalized to arbitrary GPU/AI workloads.
exit_criteria: A generic deterministic adapter interface exists with exact workload/profile/schema and reproducible input/output commitments.
A versioned governance registry pins adapters by exact address/code hash and supports fail-closed activation.
Each job freezes an exact current deterministic adapter route before execution.
Evaluation after RESULT_COMMITTED proves input preimage matches the immutable job input and output preimage matches the worker's actual committed output hash.
A deterministic adapter independently recomputes expected output and records positive or negative evidence.
Later adapter publication does not rewrite a frozen job route.
Tampered input/output, inactive/unknown routes, replay and post-execution route binding fail closed.
Deterministic evidence does not itself mutate job verdict/settlement state or grant unrelated authority.
Level 1 exact-head Compute qualification is green.
completion_note: Exact-head Level 1 qualification passed on ff8a4ca1e0d19f859be27a9718c8b768c99ea308. This evidence-only closeout changes no executable source, tests, workflow, dependency, interface, configuration semantics or deployment state.
